description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing', a pointing marker used in the Image_Graph library for rendering graphical markers with start and end points, offsets, and drawing logic.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing
classes.description: A data marker class representing a pointing marker with start and end markers, offsets, and drawing capabilities.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing
methods.description: Constructor for the pointing marker, initializes offsets and end marker.

methods.name: setMarkerStart
methods.description: Sets the starting marker (tip of the pin) and assigns its parent.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker on the canvas, including start marker, line, and end marker.
